title: ReconcileResult.have capped at MAX_HAVE with no completeness signal to caller
description: core/group_log/reconcile.rs:64-65: BFS breaks when have.len() >= MAX_HAVE. Callers receive a vec that may be truncated with no indication. The docstring explains the algorithm but does not document the capping behavior or what callers should do when len(have)==MAX_HAVE. Fix: add a boolean is_complete field to ReconcileResult (false when capped), or document in the function doc: 'If have.len() == MAX_HAVE the result is truncated; issue another reconciliation round to retrieve remaining entries.'
